claims: NASA is targeting April 1, 2026, for the launch of the Artemis II mission.
The Artemis II mission will send four astronauts on a 10-day flyby around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is currently in final preparations.
Additional launch opportunities for the Artemis II mission are available in early April 2026.
Additional launch opportunities for the Artemis II mission are available on April 30, 2026.
This video provides a countdown to the launch day of the Artemis II mission.
